## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-juan Míng-edited *yǔlù* of a classical Táng master, X69 n1333. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

[Xuěfēng Yìcún](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E5%AD%98) 雪峰義存 (822–908): one of the most important late-Táng Chán masters; abbot of Xuěfēngsì 雪峰寺 in Fúzhōu. Dharma-heir of [Déshān Xuānjiàn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%A3%E9%91%91) 德山宣鑑. Through his prominent dharma-heirs ([Yúnmén Wényǎn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E5%81%83) 雲門文偃 the founder of Yúnmén-school; [Xuánshā Shībèi](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E5%82%99) 玄沙師備 the ancestor of the Fǎyǎn-school), Xuěfēng's line produced two of the classical Chán Five Houses.

Compiler [Lín Hóngyǎn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9E%97%E5%BC%98%E8%A1%8D) 林弘衍: late-Míng lay Buddhist editor. Lifedates unrecorded.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1600 (Míng Wànlì); *notAfter* 1644 (end of Míng).
